_metadata.scope: dashboard-screens + search-screens + booking-screens + profile-screens + auth-screens + payment-screens + onboarding-screens + messaging-screens + review-screens + admin-screens + list-screens + profile-edit-screens
_metadata.description: Component schemas for programmatic Figma component generation via local development plugin. Includes 33 dashboard components + 7 search/discovery components + 15 profile/booking components + 3 auth components + 4 payment components + 4 onboarding components + 4 messaging components + 2 review components + 10 admin components + 3 list screen components + 1 profile edit component.

components.name: Navigation Header (Authenticated)
components.description: Global navigation and user context across all authenticated screens

accessibility.keyboardNav: tab through all links, enter to activate

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with role variants. Create 3 role-specific instances (Care Receiver, Caregiver, Admin). Share base structure, override navigation items per role. Responsive breakpoints: Mobile (hamburger), Tablet (condensed), Desktop (full horizontal).

components.name: Footer (Global)
components.description: Legal links, support access, and secondary navigation

accessibility.externalLinks: rel='noopener noreferrer', aria-label includes 'opens in new tab'

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with layout variants: Desktop (horizontal), Tablet (2-line), Mobile (vertical).

components.name: Skip to Main Content Link
components.description: Allow keyboard users to bypass navigation
components.figmaNotes: Shared Component (low priority for visual design). Visually hidden until keyboard focus.

components.name: Page Container
components.description: Consistent page structure with header, main content, and footer
components.figmaNotes: Template (frame structure, not component).

components.name: Content Grid
components.description: Responsive grid layout for cards, widgets, metrics
components.figmaNotes: Auto Layout Frame with variants. Mobile (320-767px): 1 column forced. Tablet (768-1023px): 2 columns. Desktop (1024+): Specified column count.

components.name: Section Card / Widget Container
components.description: Consistent container styling for dashboard widgets
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with header/footer variants. Variant: With header action | Without header action. Variant: With footer action | Without footer action.

components.name: Two-Column Layout (Main + Sidebar)
components.description: Primary content area (70%) with secondary sidebar (30%)
components.figmaNotes: Auto Layout Frame (horizontal → vertical on mobile). Desktop: Side-by-side. Tablet/Mobile: Stacked (sidebar below main).

components.name: Divider / Separator
components.description: Visual separation between content sections
components.figmaNotes: Line element with color style.

components.name: Booking Card
components.description: Display booking information with caregiver/care receiver details, status, and actions. MOST COMPLEX COMPONENT.
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with multiple variants. Property: card_type (7 variants). Property: countdown_urgency (ok, warning, urgent) - conditional. Boolean: show_earnings (caregiver view only). Boolean: show_verification_badges (search results only). Responsive variants: Desktop (horizontal layout), Mobile (vertical stack).

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Visual indicator of booking status, verification status, or system status
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with status property (dropdown with all status options). Property: status. Property: size (sm, md, lg). Auto-swap background color, text color, icon based on status. Color mapping from tokens.json status colors.

components.name: Countdown Timer
components.description: Display time remaining for time-sensitive actions
components.figmaNotes: Component with urgency variants. Property: urgency (ok, warning, urgent). Auto-swap text color based on urgency. Urgent variant includes pulsing animation notation. OK: green (#16a34a), Warning: yellow (#f59e0b), Urgent: red (#dc2626).

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Guide users when no data exists, provide next action

props.name: message
props.default: Find a caregiver to get started

accessibility.heading: H3 or H4
accessibility.screenReader: Announces empty state when list loads empty

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with type variants. Property: type (no-bookings, no-requests, etc.). Boolean: show_cta (with/without action button). Auto-swap icon, heading, message based on type.

components.name: Alert Banner
components.description: Display urgent or important messages requiring user attention
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with severity variants. Property: severity (info, warning, error, success). Boolean: show_cta. Boolean: dismissible. Auto-swap background, border, icon based on severity. Colors from tokens.json alert colors.

components.name: User Avatar / Profile Photo
components.description: Display user profile photo or initials fallback
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with size variants. Property: size (sm=32px, md=48px, lg=56px, xl=80px, 2xl=120px). Boolean: has_photo (swaps between photo layer and initials layer). Text override: initials. Background color auto-generated from user ID hash.

components.name: Metric Card / Stat Widget
components.description: Display a single metric with label, value, trend, and optional link
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with type variants. Property: type (simple, trend, detailed). Boolean: show_icon. Boolean: show_trend. Boolean: show_link.

components.name: Activity Feed Item
components.description: Display a single activity/event in a chronological list

accessibility.screenReader: Entire item announced as single sentence

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with type variants. Property: type (booking, verification, safeguarding, admin, user). Boolean: show_icon. Auto-swap icon based on type.

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary interaction element for actions (submit forms, navigate, trigger events)
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with variant properties. Property: variant (primary, secondary, destructive, ghost, link). Property: size (sm=36px, md=44px, lg=56px). Boolean: has_icon_left. Boolean: has_icon_right. Boolean: loading (swap label with spinner). Boolean: disabled (apply opacity).

components.name: Link
components.description: Navigate to another page or section

accessibility.external: rel='noopener noreferrer', icon or text indicates new tab

components.figmaNotes: Text Style with variants (not component). Define as text styles: Link Inline, Link Standalone, Link Nav.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Button with icon only, no text label
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with variant property. Property: variant (default, close, menu, notification). Property: size (sm=32px, md=40px, lg=48px). Auto-swap icon based on variant.

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Binary on/off control for settings

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to focus, Space to toggle

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with boolean property. Property: checked (boolean, swaps knob position and track color). Property: size (sm=32x18px, md=40x22px, lg=48x26px). Property: disabled (boolean, applies opacity).

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Display a list of options in a popup menu

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select, Escape to close

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with open/closed variants. Property: open (boolean, shows/hides dropdown layer). Property: type (user-menu, filter, actions). Component variant: Item (with icon, without icon, divider, destructive).

components.name: Modal / Dialog
components.description: Display content in an overlay, requiring user interaction to dismiss

accessibility.focusTrap: Tab cycles through modal elements only

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with type variants. Property: type (confirmation, form, alert, lightbox). Property: size (sm=400px, md=600px, lg=800px). Layer: Overlay (50% black). Layer: Modal card. Boolean: dismissible (shows/hides close X button).

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Single-line text input for forms
components.figmaNotes: Master Component with state variants. Property: state (empty, filled, focused, error, disabled). Boolean: required (shows asterisk). Boolean: has_icon. Boolean: has_error (shows error message).

components.name: Text Area
components.description: Multi-line text input for longer content
components.figmaNotes: Component with error variant. Similar structure to Input Field.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Single on/off option

props.name: label
props.default: I agree to the Terms of Service

accessibility.label: Associated via <label for='checkbox-id'>
accessibility.keyboard: Tab to focus, Space to toggle

components.figmaNotes: Component with checked boolean. Mobile: 24x24px for better touch target.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Display completion percentage visually
components.figmaNotes: Component with percentage property. Height: sm=8px, md=12px, lg=16px. 100% bar color changes to green.

components.name: Badge / Pill (Count Badge)
components.description: Display small count or label
components.figmaNotes: Component with variant property. Default: gray bg. Primary: sage green bg. Error: red bg. Display '99+' if count > 99.

components.name: Tag / Label
components.description: Label content with category or attribute
components.figmaNotes: Component with removable boolean. Used for service types on booking cards, filter chips.

components.name: List Item
components.description: Single item in a vertical list
components.figmaNotes: Component with divider boolean. Hover background: {colors.background.base}.

components.name: Table Row (Admin)
components.description: Single row in data table
components.figmaNotes: Component with striped boolean. Striped background every other row. Hover background if clickable.

components.name: Search Bar (Postcode + Radius)
components.description: Horizontal search bar with postcode input, radius dropdown, and search button for caregiver location-based search
components.figmaNotes: Component combining three sub-components (input, dropdown, button) in horizontal layout. Auto-layout with no gap. Focus ring applies to entire container when any child focused. Search button disabled if postcode invalid.

components.name: Caregiver Card (Search Result)
components.description: Search result card showing caregiver photo, name, distance, rating, hourly rate, services, verification badges, and favorite button

accessibility.clickable: Entire card is clickable link to caregiver profile
accessibility.favoriteButton: aria-label='Add {name} to favorites' or 'Remove {name} from favorites'

components.figmaNotes: Card component with hover state (elevated shadow). Favorite button toggles between outlined heart and filled heart. Entire card clickable. Loading variant shows skeleton placeholders for all text. Max 3 service tags shown, '+ N more' if additional.

components.name: Filter Sidebar
components.description: Collapsible filter panel with 7 filter groups: availability, hourly rate, services, verification, languages, gender, rating

accessibility.sections: Each section has collapsible region with aria-expanded

components.figmaNotes: Master Component with 7 filter sections. Each section has collapsible header. Mobile variant becomes bottom drawer. Clear All button visible only when activeFilters > 0. Apply button sticky at bottom.

components.name: Dual Range Slider
components.description: Double-handle slider for selecting hourly rate range (min/max)

accessibility.minInput: role='slider', aria-valuemin='{min}', aria-valuemax='{max}', aria-valuenow='{currentMin}', aria-label='Minimum hourly rate'
accessibility.maxInput: role='slider', aria-valuemin='{min}', aria-valuemax='{max}', aria-valuenow='{currentMax}', aria-label='Maximum hourly rate'
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys to adjust by step, Page Up/Down for larger steps

components.figmaNotes: Component with two draggable thumbs. Track fill dynamically sized between thumbs. Value labels update live. Thumb hover state increases size to 24px. Ensure min thumb cannot exceed max thumb position.

components.name: Pagination Controls
components.description: Page navigation with numbers, prev/next buttons, and result count

accessibility.previousButton: aria-label='Go to previous page', disabled when currentPage=1
accessibility.nextButton: aria-label='Go to next page', disabled when currentPage=totalPages

components.figmaNotes: Component with dynamic page number buttons. Shows max 5 page numbers, uses ellipsis if more. Current page highlighted with active background. Previous/Next buttons disabled at boundaries. Result count text shows 'Showing X-Y of Z results'.

components.name: Filter Tag (Dismissible)
components.description: Dismissible pill showing an active filter with X button to remove
components.figmaNotes: Component with hover state. Dismiss button shows X icon. Entire tag has subtle hover background. Auto-width based on label length (min 80px, max 200px). Used in active filters row.

components.name: Star Rating (Read-Only)
components.description: Visual star display (1-5 stars, supports half-stars), read-only for displaying caregiver ratings
components.figmaNotes: Component with 5 star icons. Each star can be filled, half-filled, or empty based on rating value (supports 0.5 increments). Small variant (16px stars) for compact layouts, medium (20px) for card displays. Review count shown as '(24 reviews)' next to stars.

components.name: Profile Header (Caregiver)
components.description: Large profile header with photo, name, location, distance, verification badges, star rating, hourly rate, 'Request Booking' CTA, 'Share' and 'Report' actions
components.figmaNotes: Full-width header component for caregiver profile pages. Large 120x120px photo on left, info section in middle with name, location, verification badges, rating, and hourly rate. CTA section on right with 'Request Booking' button (hidden if viewing own profile), share/report icon buttons, and stats area showing total bookings, member since date, and response time.

components.name: Availability Calendar (30-Day)
components.description: 30-day date grid showing available/booked/unavailable dates with time slots on date click
components.figmaNotes: Calendar component with 7-column grid for weekdays, 5 rows for dates. Header shows month/year with prev/next navigation arrows. Date cells color-coded: green for available, grey for booked, light grey for unavailable. Selected date has border highlight. When date clicked, time slots panel appears below grid showing morning/afternoon/evening options as pills.

components.name: Review Card (Individual)
components.description: Individual review showing reviewer avatar, name, date, star rating, review text, 'Helpful' button

props.name: reviewText
props.default: Sarah was wonderful! She was punctual, friendly, and my mother really enjoyed her company.

components.figmaNotes: Card displaying individual review. Top row has 40x40px avatar, reviewer name, date, and star rating. Review text below (truncates at 3 lines if long, 'Read more' link expands). Bottom has 'Helpful' button with count (only shown if >0).

components.name: Rating Distribution Chart (5-Bar)
components.description: Horizontal bar chart showing review count per star level (5 bars, 5-star to 1-star)
components.figmaNotes: Component showing rating breakdown. Top displays large average rating number + star rating instance. Below are 5 horizontal bar rows (5-star to 1-star), each with star label, progress bar (proportional width), and count text. No-reviews variant shows empty state message.

components.name: Verification Detail List (Status)
components.description: List of verification checks with status icons (passed/pending/not-started)
components.figmaNotes: Vertical list of verification items. Each item has status icon (checkmark green for passed, clock yellow for pending, circle grey for not started), verification name, status text, and completed date (if passed). Items have card background with border.

components.name: Caregiver Summary Card (Booking Context)
components.description: Compact caregiver info card for booking context: photo, name, rating, hourly rate, verification status. Clickable to profile.
components.figmaNotes: Compact horizontal card for booking context. 64x64px photo on left, info section with name, star rating (small), hourly rate, and verified badge (conditional). Link arrow icon on right. Entire card clickable to navigate to full profile.

components.name: Date Picker (Availability-Aware)
components.description: Calendar widget with availability highlighting for booking date selection
components.figmaNotes: Calendar widget for date selection in booking form. Header with month/year and prev/next arrows. 7-column grid of date buttons. Available dates use primary background, unavailable dates greyed out with not-allowed cursor, selected date uses secondary background, today has border highlight. Date buttons are 50x50px for accessibility.

components.name: Price Summary Card (Real-Time)
components.description: Real-time price breakdown showing hourly rate x duration, service fee, and total. Updates dynamically.
components.figmaNotes: Card showing price breakdown. Line items for hourly rate, duration, subtotal, service fee (smaller text). Divider line. Total row with highlighted background and bold text. Calculating variant shows spinner overlay. Updates dynamically as duration changes.

components.name: Duration Selector (Radio Group)
components.description: Radio button group for booking duration selection (2h, 3h, 4h, custom)
components.figmaNotes: Horizontal row of duration option buttons (each: radio circle + duration text). Selected option has active background (secondary color), inactive options have white background with border. Custom option shows input field when selected.

components.name: Breadcrumb Navigation
components.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail (e.g., Home > Search > Caregiver Name > Request Booking)
components.figmaNotes: Horizontal breadcrumb with links separated by chevron separators. Non-current items are links (muted text, clickable), current item is plain text (active color, no link). Truncated mobile variant shows ellipsis for middle items.

components.name: Booking Detail Card (Comprehensive)
components.description: Comprehensive booking info display: date, time, duration, service type, special requests, address
components.figmaNotes: Card displaying comprehensive booking details. Booking reference at top. 2-column grid of info rows (each with icon, label, value): date, time, duration, service type. Divider. Address section with icon + full address. Special requests section (conditional, expandable text). Minimal variant shows less info for pending states.

components.name: Payment Summary (Status-Aware)
components.description: Price breakdown with status-dependent text (e.g., 'Payment held' vs 'Payment released' vs 'Refunded')
components.figmaNotes: Card showing price breakdown with payment status. Status badge at top (color-coded per variant). Line items: hourly rate, duration, service fee, divider, total (bold). Payment method row with card icon + last 4 digits. Status text explains current payment state (e.g., 'Payment held in escrow' / 'Payment released to caregiver' / 'Refund processed').

components.name: Booking Timeline (Chronological)
components.description: Chronological status history with vertical timeline, timestamps and event descriptions
components.figmaNotes: Vertical timeline with events. Each event has: dot (filled for active, outline for inactive), vertical line connecting to next event (except last), timestamp (small text), event title (semibold), and optional description. Timeline column on left (30px), event content on right (flex 1).

components.name: Earnings Breakdown Card (Caregiver)
components.description: Caregiver earnings view: gross amount, platform commission deduction, net payout
components.figmaNotes: Card showing caregiver earnings breakdown. Title 'Your Earnings'. Gross amount row. Commission row (red text, shows negative value and percentage). Divider. Net payout row (highlighted background, bold, green text). Payout status text explains timeline. Payout date shown if paid.

components.name: Care Receiver Card (Privacy-Aware)
components.description: Care receiver info with privacy controls: full details after acceptance, limited before

accessibility.privacyNotice: Privacy-limited variant does not expose personal data, aria-label reflects privacy state

components.figmaNotes: Two-variant card for care receiver info. Privacy-limited: Initial avatar (circle with letter), 'Care Receiver' label, general area, privacy notice ('Full details available after acceptance'). Full: Photo (60x60px), full name, location, contact phone, contact email (conditional), 'Message' button. Height varies by variant.

components.name: Navigation Header (Public/Unauthenticated)
components.description: Minimal header for unauthenticated pages (auth screens, public pages). Logo left, 'Log In' link right.

accessibility.ctaClickable: Link to login or sign up

components.figmaNotes: Minimal public header. White background, logo left, CTA link right. Mobile: Reduce padding to 16px. Reusable across all auth screens.

components.name: Step Indicator (Multi-step Progress)
components.description: Multi-step progress indicator for registration flows. Shows current step, total steps, and step labels. Numbered circles with connecting lines.
components.figmaNotes: Horizontal step indicator. Current step: filled circle (brand link color), bold label. Future steps: outline circle, gray label. Past steps: filled circle. Connecting lines between steps. Mobile: Reduce circle size to 32px, stack labels below circles.

components.name: Trust/Security Badge Row
components.description: Row of trust/security badges (e.g., '256-bit Encrypted', 'GDPR Compliant', 'No Spam'). Used on registration screens to build trust.
components.figmaNotes: Horizontal row of pill-shaped badges. Green background (in-progress-bg), green text. Icon + label per badge. Used on auth screens to reassure users. Mobile: Allow badges to wrap to multiple rows.

components.name: Consent Checkbox Group (GDPR)
components.description: Group of consent checkboxes for GDPR compliance. Each checkbox has a label, optional link text, optional link URL, and required flag.

items.label: I'd like to receive helpful tips and updates via email

accessibility.checkboxAccessibility: Each checkbox has aria-required if required
accessibility.linkAccessibility: Link text opens in new tab, aria-label includes context

components.figmaNotes: Vertical stack of consent checkboxes. Each row: checkbox + label + optional link + optional asterisk (required). Link text underlined and brand color. Used on all registration forms. Helper text below group (e.g., 'You can unsubscribe anytime').

components.name: Verification Code Input (6-digit OTP)
components.description: 6-digit code entry for phone verification. Row of 6 individual digit boxes. Auto-advances to next box when digit entered.

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate, Backspace deletes and moves back, Paste auto-fills all boxes

components.figmaNotes: 6 boxes in a row (desktop) or 2x3 grid (mobile). Each box: 56x56px (desktop), 48x48px (mobile). White background, gray border, centered digit text (24px). Auto-advance on digit entry. Error state: red border on all boxes. Empty state: show placeholder circle or dash.

components.name: Password Strength Meter
components.description: Visual password strength indicator. 4-segment bar with color-coded strength levels (weak, fair, strong, very-strong). Real-time updates as user types.
components.figmaNotes: 4-segment horizontal bar. Weak: 1 red segment. Fair: 2 amber segments. Strong: 3 green segments. Very strong: 4 green segments. Unfilled segments: light gray. Label below bar shows strength text. Updates in real-time as user types. Place directly below password input field.

components.name: Saved Card Item
components.description: Row displaying a saved payment card with brand icon, masked number, expiry, status badge, and action buttons
components.figmaNotes: Card row: left-aligned brand icon placeholder (48x32 rounded rect), masked card number, expiry date below. Right side: 'Default' green badge or 'Expired' red badge, then 'Set as Default' and 'Remove' buttons. Remove button uses destructive red border.

components.name: Stripe Secure Card Input
components.description: Representation of Stripe Elements secure card input form with card number, expiry, CVC, cardholder name, and billing postcode
components.figmaNotes: Five input fields: Card number (full width with lock icon), Expiry + CVC (side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile), Cardholder name (full width), Billing postcode (full width). All inputs use standard input-field styling. Lock icon on card number indicates Stripe secure iframe.

components.name: Payout Status Card
components.description: Shows bank connection status for caregiver payouts via Stripe Connect
components.figmaNotes: Not connected: gray 'Not Connected' pill badge + prominent green 'Set Up Payouts' button. Connected: green 'Connected' pill badge + bank name + masked account number + secondary 'Update Payout Method' button.

components.name: Earnings Metric Row
components.description: Horizontal row of earnings metrics (total earned, pending payouts, next payout)
components.figmaNotes: Desktop: 3 columns equally spaced. Each column has muted label text above and bold value below. Mobile: stacked rows with label left-aligned and value right-aligned. Values use metric-value typography for desktop, slightly smaller for mobile.

components.name: File Upload (Drag & Drop)
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload zone with dashed border, file icon, format/size guidance. Used for document uploads (ID, passport, DBS certificate, profile photo).

props.name: dragDropText
props.default: Drag and drop your file here, or click to browse

components.figmaNotes: Dashed border (2px, 8/4 pattern). File icon centered above text. Desktop shows drag-and-drop text, mobile shows 'Tap to upload'. Circle variant used for profile photo with 150px preview circle. Rectangle is 140px tall with centered content.

components.name: Availability Grid
components.description: 7-day x 3-period weekly schedule grid with toggleable cells. Used in caregiver onboarding Step 3.
components.figmaNotes: Grid with day labels on left, period headers on top. Selected cells have blue tinted background with checkmark. Unselected cells have light border. Mobile abbreviates day names (Mon, Tue...) and period names. Grid is centered in parent. Uses role=grid for accessibility with arrow key navigation.

components.name: Radio Button Group
components.description: Vertical list of radio buttons with optional group label. Used for verification method selection (UK passport vs UKVI share code).
components.figmaNotes: Each option is a 32px-tall row with 20px circle (outer ring 2px stroke, inner fill 10px for selected). Label text 14px aligned after 32px offset. Group label bold 14px above options with 12px gap. Selected state: blue outer ring + blue inner circle. Unselected: gray outer ring only.

components.name: Verification Status Card
components.description: Card showing verification item with status badge and action button. Used in caregiver onboarding Step 5 for Identity, Right to Work, and DBS verification links.
components.figmaNotes: Card with 8px border-radius and 1px border. Title (15px bold) top-left, status badge (pill) top-right. Description (13px muted) below title. Action button (brand color) bottom-right. Optional variant adds blue 'OPTIONAL' pill badge after title and 'Skip for now' text link below action button. Status badge colors: not-submitted (gray), pending (amber), verified (green), rejected (red).

components.name: Message Bubble
components.description: Chat message bubble with three variants: own (right-aligned, light blue), other (left-aligned, gray), system (centered, yellow). Supports sender name, timestamp, read receipts, and contact redaction alerts.
components.figmaNotes: Own messages right-aligned with light blue (#E0F2FE) background, 8px border-radius, 16px padding. Timestamp + read receipt below right. Other messages left-aligned with gray (#F3F4F6) background. Sender name + timestamp below left. System messages centered with yellow (#FEF3C7) background. All text 14px, timestamps 12px gray.

components.name: Message Input
components.description: Message composition area with auto-resizing textarea, character counter, and send button.
components.figmaNotes: Textarea with 8px border-radius, 1px border, white fill. Placeholder text 14px gray. Character counter 12px gray top-right. Send button brand color below right. Desktop textarea 80px, mobile 60px. Desktop send button 48px, mobile 56px.

components.name: Date Divider
components.description: Horizontal line divider with centered date label (Today, Yesterday, or specific date).
components.figmaNotes: Thin horizontal line (#E5E7EB) with centered label text in 12px gray. Line breaks around label with 4px gap on each side.

components.name: Typing Indicator
components.description: Shows that another participant is typing with three animated dots and participant name.
components.figmaNotes: Three 3px radius dots in blue (#3B82F6) with increasing opacity (0.4, 0.6, 0.8), spaced 8px apart. Followed by '[Name] is typing...' in 13px italic gray. In Figma, animate dots with Smart Animate (pulse effect).

components.name: Star Rating Input
components.description: Interactive 5-star rating input with hover/click states and label text below each star. Stars rendered as polygons.
components.figmaNotes: Stars are 48x48px desktop, 56x56px mobile. Filled stars yellow (#F59E0B), empty stars gray outline (#D1D5DB). Stars centered horizontally with 16px gap. Labels below each star in 12px gray. Mobile shows condensed labels (Poor/Good/Excellent only). In Figma, use component variants for 0-5 selected states. Hover state fills stars up to cursor. Use role=radiogroup with role=radio per star.

components.name: Booking Summary Card (Review)
components.description: Card showing booking context for the review screen: caregiver photo, name, verification badges, rating, and booking date/time/duration/service.
components.figmaNotes: White card with 8px border-radius and 1px border. 'BOOKING SUMMARY' label 11px uppercase gray. Caregiver photo (80px desktop, 60px mobile) circle left, name + badges + rating right. Below: Date/Time/Duration/Service rows in 13px with label gray and value primary.

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Sortable data table with column headers, badge cells, row highlighting, and kebab action menus. Used for user management, safeguarding reports, and other admin list views.

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of { label, name? } column header objects

props.name: rows
props.description: Array of row objects. Each row has 'cells' array (strings or badge objects with text/badge/badgeColor/badgeTextColor/color) and optional 'highlight' (urgent/warning)

props.name: resultsText
props.description: Results count text shown below the table, e.g. 'Showing 1-20 of 23 users'

components.figmaNotes: Rounded 8px container with 1px border. Header row #F9FAFB with 11px uppercase semibold labels. Data rows alternate white. Badge cells render as small rounded pills. Urgent rows get #FEE2E2 background. Each row has a kebab (3-dot) action menu icon on the right.

components.name: Filter Bar
components.description: Horizontal filter bar with optional search input, dropdown filters, and clear/apply action buttons. Responsive: stacks vertically on mobile.

props.name: hasSearch
props.description: Whether to show a search input field

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder text for search input

props.name: filters
props.description: Array of { label } filter dropdown objects

components.figmaNotes: Light blue-gray container (#F8FAFC) with 8px border-radius. Search input (if enabled) takes ~40% width on desktop. Filter dropdowns are 120px wide with chevron-down icon. 'Clear' secondary button and 'Apply' primary button right-aligned. On mobile, all elements stack vertically full-width.

components.name: Verification Queue Card
components.description: Card showing a caregiver's verification status with avatar, SLA tracking badge, document checklist, and review action buttons.

props.name: name
props.description: Caregiver name

props.name: appliedDate
props.description: Application date with relative time, e.g. '3 days ago (15/01/2026)'

props.name: slaStatus
props.description: SLA status: breached | approaching | on-track

props.name: slaPending
props.description: Pending time text, e.g. '72h pending'

props.name: checklist
props.description: Array of { type, status (submitted|not-submitted), date } verification items

components.figmaNotes: White card with 8px border-radius. Left: 48px gray avatar circle with initials. Right: Name (16px bold), applied date (12px gray), SLA badge (colored pill matching status). Below: checklist with checkmark/x icons per document type. Bottom: 'Review' primary button + 'Skip' secondary button side by side.

components.name: Settings Navigation Sidebar
components.description: Vertical navigation sidebar for system settings categories. Shows active state with left accent bar and background highlight. Supports badges for status indicators.

props.name: activeCategory
props.description: ID of the currently active category

props.name: categories
props.description: Array of { id, label, icon, badge? } category objects

components.figmaNotes: White sidebar card with 8px border-radius. Each category is a row with icon + label. Active row has #EFF6FF background and 3px left blue accent bar. Badges appear right-aligned in 10px gray text. On mobile/tablet, this becomes a horizontal scrollable tab bar.

components.name: Info Box Calculation
components.description: Bordered information box showing a financial calculation breakdown with label-value pairs, dividers, subtotals, and totals. Used in system settings for commission/fee examples.

props.name: title
props.description: Box title, e.g. 'Example Booking Calculation:'

props.name: lines
props.description: Array of line objects: { label, value, style? (divider|subtotal|total) }

components.figmaNotes: Light blue bordered box (#F0F9FF bg, #BAE6FD border). Title at top in 14px semibold. Each line is a horizontal label-value pair. Divider lines are 1px #BAE6FD. Subtotal lines use semibold. Total line gets #DBEAFE background highlight with bold text.

components.name: Audit Log Table
components.description: Compact table showing recent system setting changes with date, admin name, category, field, old value, and new value columns.

props.name: entries
props.description: Array of { date, admin, category, field, oldValue, newValue } audit entries

components.figmaNotes: Compact table with 'Recent Changes' heading (14px semibold). Header row in #F9FAFB with 10px uppercase labels. Data rows in 12px. Old values shown in red with strikethrough, new values in green. 6 columns: Date, Admin, Category, Field, Old, New.

components.name: Super Admin Badge
components.description: Small orange badge indicating super-admin-only access. Displayed next to page titles on restricted admin screens.

props.name: label
props.description: Badge label text

components.figmaNotes: Small inline badge with orange background (#FED7AA) and dark orange text (#C2410C). 10px bold uppercase text. 4px border-radius. Typically placed inline next to a page heading.

components.name: Placeholder Badge
components.description: Yellow badge indicating a value is a placeholder pending a founder decision (FDR). Used to flag configurable values that are not yet finalized.

props.name: label
props.description: Badge label text

components.figmaNotes: Small inline badge with yellow background (#FEF3C7) and dark amber text (#92400E). 10px semibold text. 4px border-radius. Placed near form fields whose values are pending a founder decision.

components.name: Filter Tag Row
components.description: Horizontal row of active filter tags with dismiss (x) buttons. Shows currently applied filters that can be individually removed.

props.name: tags
props.description: Array of tag label strings, e.g. ['Role: Caregiver', 'Status: Suspended']

components.figmaNotes: Horizontal flex row with 8px gap. Each tag is a light blue pill (#EFF6FF) with blue text (#1D4ED8), 12px font, 12px border-radius. Each tag has a small 'x' dismiss icon on the right side.

components.name: Bulk Actions Toolbar
components.description: Floating toolbar shown when table rows are selected. Displays selected count and action buttons (e.g., Suspend, Activate, Export).

props.name: selectedCount
props.description: Number of selected items

props.name: actions
props.description: Array of { label, variant? } action button objects

components.figmaNotes: Dark toolbar (#1E293B) with white text. Left side shows '3 users selected' count. Right side has action buttons (outlined white for secondary, solid white-on-blue for primary). 8px border-radius. Appears at the bottom of the table area when rows are checkbox-selected.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Horizontal tab navigation with active state indicator and optional count badges. Used for filtering content on list screens (bookings, messages).

props.name: tabs
props.description: Array of { label, count? } objects defining each tab

props.name: activeTab
props.description: Zero-based index of the currently active tab

components.figmaNotes: Full-width horizontal bar with evenly spaced tab labels. Active tab has brand-blue (#2563EB) text and a 2px bottom border indicator. Inactive tabs are muted (#64748B). Count badges appear as small rounded pills next to each label. On mobile, tabs scroll horizontally if they overflow.

components.name: Conversation Row
components.description: Single row in the message inbox list. Displays participant avatar, name, thread context, message preview, timestamp, and unread badge.

props.name: conversations
props.description: Array of conversation objects with: name, threadType, preview, time, unread (number)

states.name: unread
states.description: Bold name, darker preview text, light blue-gray background, red unread count badge

states.name: empty
states.description: Empty state with illustration and 'No conversations yet' message

components.figmaNotes: Each row has a circular avatar (initials) on the left, then a two-line content area (name + thread type on line 1, preview on line 2), and timestamp + unread badge on the right. Unread rows have a subtle #F8FAFC background tint and bolder text. The red unread badge is a small circle with white count text. Rows are clickable (hover shows #F1F5F9 background). On mobile, preview text is truncated to one line.

components.name: Booking List Card
components.description: Card displaying a single booking in a list view. Shows participant info, status badge, date/time, services, amount/earnings, and contextual action buttons.

props.name: bookings
props.description: Array of booking objects with: name, status, date, time, duration, services, amount, earnings?, earningsNote?, location?, countdown?, actions[]

actionButtons.secondaryVariant: View Details, Message, Cancel, Decline, Cancel Request, Book Again, Leave Review

states.name: confirmed
states.description: Green status badge, View Details + Message + Cancel actions

states.name: pending
states.description: Amber status badge with countdown timer, Accept + Decline + Message actions (caregiver), View Details + Cancel Request actions (care receiver)

states.name: completed
states.description: Gray status badge, View Details + optional Leave Review + Book Again actions

states.name: cancelled
states.description: Red status badge, View Details only

states.name: declined
states.description: Red status badge, View Details only

states.name: empty
states.description: Empty state illustration with contextual message and CTA button

components.figmaNotes: Each card is a white rounded rectangle with subtle border. Left side has avatar circle (initials), name in bold, and status badge pill. Center has date/time line, duration, and services. Right side has amount (or earnings + commission note for caregivers) right-aligned. Action buttons are at the bottom-right of each card. Pending bookings show an amber countdown badge below the status. Cards have a subtle hover shadow. On mobile, layout stacks vertically with amount moving below details.

components.name: Multi-Select Tags
components.description: Tag-based multi-select input for choosing multiple options from a predefined list. Displays selected items as removable pills/tags and provides a dropdown or autocomplete for adding more.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label displayed above the tags area

props.name: selected
props.description: Array of currently selected tag strings

props.name: options
props.description: Array of all available option strings

props.name: helpText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the tags area

states.name: default
states.description: Shows selected tags with add button

states.name: empty
states.description: No tags selected, placeholder text shown

states.name: disabled
states.description: All tags shown but not removable, no add button

components.figmaNotes: Renders as a bordered container with tag pills inside. Each tag is a rounded pill with text and an X remove button. An '+ Add' link at the end opens a dropdown of available options (filtering out already-selected items). On mobile, tags wrap to multiple lines. Use for languages, interests, and similar multi-value profile fields.
